title: Bar Salts Lemon & Lime Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the sharp and clean notes of Lemon Lime with this flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts range. This 30ml bottle provides a zesty and refreshing taste, perfect for vapers who appreciate a bright and tangy flavour profile in their DIY e-liquids. The concentrate allows for flexible e-liquid creation, letting you adjust the nicotine strength and VG/PG ratio by adding nicotine shots and a base mix according to your preferences. It’s an excellent choice for crafting a personalized vaping experience with a vibrant citrus kick. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
